findings.title: Recipe still says a counter at its max shows `norn run rerun <unit>`
findings.detail:
"You see: an Unblock item with the reason (died, stalled, timeout, a counter at its max) and `norn run rerun <unit>`." After gh-212, a counter at its max shows `norn run rerun <unit> --step <to> --reset <counter>`. The docs lint does not catch it since the command is still valid.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say that a counter at its max offers the edge's target with the counter reset (W4), and that a plain rerun warns.
